Private wb As Object

Public Sub Setup()
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
End Sub

Public Sub Reopen(ByVal folder As String)
    Dim path As String
    path = folder & Application.PathSeparator & "values.xlsx"
    wb.SaveAs path, xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    wb.Close False
    Set wb = Workbooks.Open(path)
End Sub

Public Sub Finish()
    wb.Close False
End Sub

Private Function Show(v As Variant) As String
    If IsNull(v) Then
        Show = "Null"
    ElseIf IsEmpty(v) Then
        Show = "Empty"
    ElseIf IsObject(v) Then
        Show = "Object " & TypeName(v)
    ElseIf IsArray(v) Then
        Show = TypeName(v)
    ElseIf IsError(v) Then
        Show = "Error " & CStr(v)
    ElseIf Len(CStr(v)) > 60 Then
        Show = TypeName(v) & " " & Len(CStr(v))
    Else
        Show = TypeName(v) & " " & CStr(v)
    End If
End Function

Private Function State(c As Object) As String
    Dim s As String, v As Variant
    On Error Resume Next
    v = Empty
    v = c.Cells(1, 1).Value
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then
        s = s & "|e" & Err.Number
        Err.Clear
    Else
        s = s & "|" & Show(v)
    End If
    v = Empty

        Err.Clear

    End If
    v = Empty

    If Err.Number <> 0 Then
        s = s & "|e" & Err.Number
        Err.Clear
    Else
        s = s & "|" & Show(v)
    End If
    v = Empty
    v = c.Cells(1, 1).Style
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then
        s = s & "|e" & Err.Number
        Err.Clear
    Else
        s = s & "|" & Show(v)
    End If
    State = s
End Function
